title: Arvind Sivakumaran
description: Arvind graduated in Film Production from Victoria Motion Picture School in British Columbia, Canada, where he specialized in directing and screenplay writing. With a strong foundation in both cinema and literature, he has worked on independent film projects, film analysis, and academic research. Having lived and studied across different cultures, Arvind brings a unique perspective to his creative work.

education.institution: Victoria Motion Picture School, B.C., Canada

title: Steven Hanulik
description: Visionary director known for innovative storytelling and striking visual language. With a background in both classical cinema and contemporary digital storytelling, Steven has directed short films, commercials, and music videos across multiple markets. His recent work 'Echoes of Tomorrow' premiered at Sundance to critical acclaim.

title: Vinay Choudary
description: Award-winning writer specializing in psychological thrillers and character-driven narratives. His portfolio includes long-format television, feature film scripts, and digital series. Notable credits include 'Midnight Confession' and 'The Last Memory.'
